sources.entry: ML for Beginners - Microsoft Scikit-learn project curriculum. #free

summary.name: ML for Beginners
summary.one_liner: A free 12-week, 26-lesson classic machine learning curriculum from Microsoft that uses Scikit-learn and avoids deep learning.
use_cases: Learn classic machine learning from scratch
Build regression, classification and clustering projects
Practice NLP and sentiment analysis with Python
Teach a machine learning class using project-based lessons
Run lessons in a browser with GitHub Codespaces
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a 12-week, 26-lesson curriculum covering classic machine learning, mainly with Scikit-learn in Python. Topics include regression, classification, clustering, natural language processing, time series forecasting and reinforcement learning, each organised around a themed project such as pumpkin prices or European hotel reviews. Each lesson has pre- and post-lecture quizzes, written instructions, a solution, and an assignment. Quizzes are in a separate Quiz App folder, and many lessons also have R versions in the /solution folder. The page also lists 50+ translated languages and offers a sparse checkout command to skip translations when cloning.
notable: 26 lessons with pre- and post-lecture quizzes (52 quizzes total) and a project in each lesson
Translated into 50+ languages, with a sparse checkout option to reduce clone size
Many lessons have R versions in addition to Python
Covers classic ML only; deep learning is in the separate AI for Beginners curriculum
caveats: Focuses on classic machine learning and avoids deep learning
Requires local Python setup or GitHub Codespaces to run lessons
Quiz app must be hosted locally or deployed to Azure to run quizzes
